messages:
Maria (Sales): kicking off Orbit Health POC thread — goal: 6-week pilot to validate claims summarization + embed search
Ajay (Solutions Eng): quick context: customer will send PHI-ish docs, want on-prem but open to Dedicated for MVP. key asks: latency < 400ms p95, token cost under $0.002/token, and regression gates on golden prompts
Tess (Platform PM): noted. timeline proposal: week0 ingest + small seed goldens, week1 baseline eval, week3 tuning, week5 canary, week6 handoff
Sam (ML Eng): for eval harness I'm thinking 3 buckets: golden (50), edge/failure cases (100), random sample (200). scoring schema: strict syntactic + semantic overlap + clinical safety flag
Nadia (Security): reminder — must complete security questionnaire before any data moves. ask: SOC2 + KMS integration + data residency. can we run a table of which deployment satisfies what?
Maria (Sales): customer also asked about pricing — they want committed throughput for 3 months. can we give a Dedicated quote + overage rate? cc @Ajay
Ajay (Solutions Eng): yes, I'll follow up with pricing ops. rough numbers: reserved pool 2xA10s equivalent, monthly commit + 15% overage. will confirm
Sam (ML Eng): Eval details: use normalized BLEU-ish + embedding cosine thresholds + human-in-loop for 10% samples. define pass if macro-F1 > 0.78 and no PII leakage incidents in human review
Tess (Platform PM): rollout policy: if regression detected on gate set, traffic falls back to baseline model; auto-rollback if safety flag > 0.1
Maria (Sales): ok. customer legal asked about deletion guarantees — can we commit to 30-day ephemeral KV cache and log retention policy? @Nadia
Nadia (Security): yes but need to confirm with infra — will require contract language for data retention and KMS key ownership. put on SOC questionnaire
Ajay (Solutions Eng): one blocker: customer uses custom tokenization pipeline. for scoring we need to align token counts — propose shipping a tokenizer parity test in week0
Sam (ML Eng): agree. will add tokenizer parity test to harness. code snippet for harness runner in thread:
```
python harness/run_eval.py --golden seed.json --edge edge.json --thresholds config.yaml
```
Maria (Sales): customer wants granular metrics per-prompt and per-model version. doable? @Tess
Tess (Platform PM): yes, Console can emit per-route metrics and we can attach per-prompt IDs in the payload. storage retention for metrics configurable.
Ajay (Solutions Eng): scoring rubric detail: for clinical correctness use a two-tier label: Correct / NotCorrect and SafetyFlag {None, Mild, Severe}. combine into pass/fail per prompt
Sam (ML Eng): regression gates: require 0.5% tolerance for major metrics, 1.5% for minor. automatic alerting to slack channel #release-war-room
Nadia (Security): also need penetration test scheduling and data flow diagram before the pilot. add to week0 checklist
Maria (Sales): next steps: Ajay to send Dedicated pricing & SOW draft by Tue, Tess to provision test route and metrics export, Sam to seed goldens + harness scaffolding, Nadia to return security questionnaire items
Ajay (Solutions Eng): will do. tagging @CI-Bot to create a ticket
CI-Bot: Created ticket INF-4123: orbit-pilot-pricing-sow
Maria (Sales): thanks all. short sync next Mon 9am PT to confirm week0 deliverables :thumbsup:
Tess (Platform PM): noted, calendar invite sent :calendar:
Sam (ML Eng): will start assembling golden set today
Nadia (Security): uploading initial SQ items to the doc repo — sharing link in channel
Maria (Sales): great — keeping this thread as single source of truth for the POC plan. cheers
